instruction: NaLonni's standing request from 2026-09-29: make the Kolmari Guide chatbot answer user questions in production. After she fixed billing on dev.meta.ai ('sorted'), the live retest showed Meta now responds but with an empty answer body, so the widget shows 'did not return a usable answer'. This contract covers the response-handling fix: parse message content robustly (string or multipart array), raise max_tokens to 4000 for the reasoning model's headroom, use the trimmed API key in the auth header, and include a short diagnostic summary when the reply is empty.
supersedeNote: sld-033 added provider error surfacing and the developer role. It is archived at .sld/archive/sld-033-chat-provider-errors.json. This contract covers only the empty-reply handling fix.
objective: Fix the /api/chat empty-reply failure without touching anything outside the listed files or the SLD engine itself. The maintenance grant is declared solely to archive superseded sld-033 under .sld/.
